message: data-on needs a key, e.g. data-on:<event>="expr".
The browser lowercases attribute names, so this listens for keydown, the DOM event. Write data-on:keydown.
The browser lowercases attribute names, so this listens for click, the DOM event. Write data-on:click.
The browser lowercases attribute names, so this reaches Datastar as the event domcontentloaded, not DOMContentLoaded. Write data-on:d-o-m-content-loaded__case.pascal: keys are kebab-case.
Datastar runs the interval every 0 ms with __duration.0ms, as often as the browser allows. Write a duration such as __duration.1s.
__debounce without a duration waits 0 ms. Write a duration such as __debounce.500ms or __debounce.1s.
Datastar reads no duration from __debounce.abc and waits 0 ms. Write a duration such as __debounce.500ms or __debounce.1s.
Datastar reads __threshold.0.5 as 0: a dot separates arguments, and the threshold is a percentage. Write __threshold.50.
Datastar reads only the last __debounce, __debounce.1s, and ignores this one.
data-on-raf is a Datastar Pro attribute; it needs the Pro bundle.
evt is undefined in data-text: Datastar hands an expression the event only in data-on, so reading from it throws a TypeError.
Datastar expression: Unexpected keyword 'this'. If data-text is another library's here, data-ignore on the element, or an aliased bundle, keeps Datastar off it.
data-on-signal-patch-filter does nothing without data-on-signal-patch on the same element, which reads it.
Datastar rewrites $n and leaves the $ before it, so the browser reads $$ as a JavaScript variable and throws a ReferenceError.
This sets view-box, but SVG reads viewBox, a name with a capital, which the object form keeps: data-attr="{viewBox: ...}".
Datastar expression: await is only valid in an async function, and Datastar compiles an expression as a plain one. An action sends its request without it.
